pages.title: Two kinds of numbers
pages.text: $(bold)Changeable$(): every config field, every JSON under $(thing)data$(), recipes and tags. Applied with $(thing)/reload$() or a restart, no compile needed.$(br2)All livestock stat numbers (decay / restore / feeding gain / weight step / manure chance / fly-bite penalty) and trough parameters now live in the common config — see "Animal stats and trough" in the config chapter.$(br2)$(bold)Fixed$(): constants still in code, such as the 600-tick decay cycle, 100-tick drink cycle, per-chunk manure cap, manure / fly check radii, litter size, delivery volume and distance, and the salt-pile random-tick chance. These need a source edit and recompile.

pages.title: Where the constants live
pages.text: $(li)Livestock: $(thing)AnimalStatsManager$() — 600-tick decay, 100-tick drink, 6 per chunk, fly check radius 3, stat bounds 0~10; $(bold)actual numbers come from the config$().$(br)$(li)Trough: $(thing)FeedingTroughBlockEntity$() — call radius, 2 s re-path, 30 s patience; numbers also from the config.$(br)$(li)Breeding: $(thing)SyringeHandler$() and $(thing)PregnancyHandler$() — 8 minutes, line 7, 3~5 babies.$(br)$(li)Delivery: $(thing)DeliveryManager$() — 3 orders, 8 minutes, 200~600 blocks, 1 yuan per 10 blocks.$(br)$(li)Salt: $(thing)SaltPanBlock$() 200 ticks, $(thing)SaltPileBlock$() 1/3.

pages.title: Before editing code
pages.text: $(li)Check whether you really must: most "too grindy / too generous" complaints can be fixed with economy config and data packs.$(br)$(li)A source edit means recompiling, releasing, and making every player update — expensive for a pack.$(br)$(li)If a value should scale with difficulty, prefer shipping several data packs over changing code.$(br2)This applies to any mod with hard-coded constants, not just this one.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: $(li)Nothing happened: make sure the file is inside the $(bold)world's$() $(thing)datapacks$() folder, or installed as a global pack.$(br)$(li)Tags not applied: they bind on the next reload; re-enter the world after $(thing)/reload$().$(br)$(li)Config not applied: COMMON configs are read by the server, so re-enter the world even in single player.$(br)$(li)Check the log: loaders print the file name of every entry that failed to parse.
